standard.summary: 权重压缩与模块级 offload 同时开启时的放行开关。默认关闭，此时两者同开会被判定为冲突、直接失败。
standard.effect: 关闭时 compression + module_offload 让决策 ok=False 并给出明文冲突原因；打开则不拦，但两条显存路径同时生效，出问题更难定位。
standard.whenToUse: 确实需要同时压权重和挪模块、并且已经做好会难查问题的准备时。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认别开。冲突提示出现时，先考虑只留其中一条路径，而不是把这个开关打开。

standard_en.summary: The release valve for running weight compression and module-level offload at the same time. Off by default, in which case the combination is reported as a conflict and fails.
standard_en.effect: While off, compression + module_offload makes the decision ok=False with an explicit conflict reason; while on it is not blocked, but both VRAM paths are live at once and problems are much harder to localise.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only when you genuinely need both compressed weights and moved modules, and accept that debugging gets harder.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep it off by default. When the conflict appears, drop one of the two paths rather than flipping this switch.

advanced.principle: quant/train_quant_product 的决策函数读 compression_on、module_offload_enabled 与这个开关：三者同时成立且未放行时写 conflicts 并把 ok 置假。它是一条「允许组合」的闸，不是压缩或 offload 的开关本身。
advanced.intervention: 训练量化决策阶段的一次组合校验，不改变任一条路径的实现。
advanced.expectedImpact: 打开后不带来额外收益，只是不再被拦；显存占用仍由压缩与 offload 各自决定。
advanced.tradeoffs: 两条路径的显存账不叠加也不抵消，同时开启时峰值取决于执行顺序；官方口径是「不推荐」，因为排查难度显著上升。

advanced_en.principle: The decision function in quant/train_quant_product reads compression_on, module_offload_enabled and this switch: when all three hold and the combo is not released, it records a conflict and sets ok to false. It is a permission gate for the combination, not a switch for compression or offload themselves.
advanced_en.intervention: One combination check during the training-quantisation decision; neither path's implementation changes.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Turning it on brings no extra benefit beyond not being blocked; VRAM use is still decided by compression and offload individually.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The two paths' memory budgets neither add up nor cancel out; with both on the peak depends on execution order, and the product stance is "not recommended" because diagnosis becomes markedly harder.
